import os

    print(root,f)

for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws=wb[name]; wsf=wf[name]
    print('SHEET',name, ws.max_row, ws.max_column)
    for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row,4)+1):
        row=[]
        for c in range(1, ws.max_column+1):
            v=ws.cell(r,c).value; fv=wsf.cell(r,c).value
            row.append((ws.cell(r,c).coordinate, repr(v), type(v).__name__, repr(fv) if isinstance(fv,str) and fv.startswith('=') else ''))
        print(row)
    print('---')
